    # find pStyle values used
    import re
    styles = re.findall(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', data)

    print("pStyle counts:", Counter(styles))

    # Show all headings via style names containing Heading/Title plus their text

    print("---- context around pStyle occurrences ----")
    # Simple heuristic: find each w:pStyle and print next 600 chars
    for m in re.finditer(r'<w:pStyle w:val="(Heading[0-9]|Title|Subtitle)"', data):
        start = m.start()
        snippet = data[start:start+1200]
        print("-----")
        print(snippet[:1200])

import re, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

PATH = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
U_TAG = '<w:u w:val="single"/>'

def main():
    with open(PATH, encoding="ascii") as f:
        raw = f.read()

    # Identify headline paragraphs: non-empty all-caps text (report uses
    # plain uppercase lines as section headlines; body text has lowercase).
    root = ET.fromstring(raw)
    headlines = []
    for p in root.iter(W + "p"):
        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(W + "t"))
        if text and text.isupper():
            headlines.append(text)
    if not headlines:
        sys.exit("error: no all-caps headline paragraphs found")
    seen = set()
    for h in headlines:
        seen.add(h)

    # Insert <w:u w:val="single"/> into the run properties of each headline
    # run, directly before its closing </w:rPr>.
    edits = []
    for h in sorted(seen):
        pat = re.compile(
            r"<w:r>\s*<w:rPr>(?P<rpr>.*?)</w:rPr>\s*<w:t[^>]*>"
            + re.escape(h) + r"</w:t>",
            re.S)
        for m in pat.finditer(raw):
            if U_TAG in m.group("rpr"):
                continue
            close = m.start() + m.group(0).index("</w:rPr>")
            edits.append(close)

    for i in sorted(edits, reverse=True):
        raw = raw[:i] + U_TAG + raw[i:]

    ET.fromstring(raw)  # well-formedness check before saving
    with open(PATH, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(raw)
    print("Underlined %d headline run(s): %s"
          % (len(edits), "; ".join(sorted(seen))))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import re, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
U_TAG = '<w:u w:val="single"/>'

def main():
    path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "unpacked/word/document.xml"
    with open(path, encoding="ascii") as f:
        raw = f.read()

    # Identify headline paragraphs: non-empty all-caps text (report uses
    # plain uppercase lines as section headlines; body text has lowercase).
    root = ET.fromstring(raw)
    headlines = []
    for p in root.iter(W + "p"):
        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(W + "t"))
        if text and text.isupper():
            headlines.append(text)
    if not headlines:
        sys.exit("error: no all-caps headline paragraphs found")
    seen = set(headlines)

    # Remove any pre-existing underline tags (restore baseline).
    raw = raw.replace(U_TAG, "")

    # For each headline occurrence, anchor on the run that ends with the
    # headline text (</w:t> followed by </w:r>), then insert <w:u> before the
    # LAST </w:rPr> inside that run's segment (its own run properties).
    edits = []
    for h in sorted(seen):
        pat = re.compile(
            r"<w:r>(?P<run>.*?)<w:t[^>]*>" + re.escape(h)
            + r"</w:t>\s*</w:r>",
            re.S)
        for m in pat.finditer(raw):
            run = m.group("run")
            rpr_open = run.rfind("<w:rPr>")
            rpr_close = run.rfind("</w:rPr>")
            if rpr_open == -1 or rpr_close == -1 or rpr_open > rpr_close:
                # Run has no run properties; create one right after <w:r>.
                edits.append((m.start("run") + len("<w:r>"),
                              "<w:rPr>" + U_TAG + "</w:rPr>"))
            else:
                rpr = run[rpr_open + len("<w:rPr>"):rpr_close]
                if U_TAG in rpr:
                    continue
                edits.append((m.start("run") + rpr_close, U_TAG))

    for idx, text in sorted(edits, key=lambda e: e[0], reverse=True):
        raw = raw[:idx] + text + raw[idx:]

    root = ET.fromstring(raw)  # well-formedness check before saving
    total_u = raw.count(U_TAG)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(raw)
    print("Underlined %d headline run(s) (%d <w:u> tag(s)); %s"
          % (len(edits), total_u, "; ".join(sorted(seen))))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import re, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

PATH = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
U_TAG = '<w:u w:val="single"/>'

def main():
    with open(PATH, encoding="ascii") as f:
        raw = f.read()

    # Identify headline paragraphs: non-empty all-caps text (report uses
    # plain uppercase lines as section headlines; body text has lowercase).
    root = ET.fromstring(raw)
    headlines = []
    for p in root.iter(W + "p"):
        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(W + "t"))
        if text and text.isupper():
            headlines.append(text)
    if not headlines:
        sys.exit("error: no all-caps headline paragraphs found")
    seen = set()
    for h in headlines:
        seen.add(h)

    # Insert <w:u w:val="single"/> into the run properties of each headline
    # run, directly before its closing </w:rPr>.
    edits = []
    for h in sorted(seen):
        pat = re.compile(
            r"<w:r>\s*<w:rPr>(?P<rpr>.*?)</w:rPr>\s*<w:t[^>]*>"
            + re.escape(h) + r"</w:t>",
            re.S)
        for m in pat.finditer(raw):
            if U_TAG in m.group("rpr"):
                continue
            close = m.start() + m.group(0).index("</w:rPr>")
            edits.append(close)

    for i in sorted(edits, reverse=True):
        raw = raw[:i] + U_TAG + raw[i:]

    ET.fromstring(raw)  # well-formedness check before saving
    with open(PATH, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(raw)
    print("Underlined %d headline run(s): %s"
          % (len(edits), "; ".join(sorted(seen))))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import re, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
U_TAG = '<w:u w:val="single"/>'

def main():
    path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "unpacked/word/document.xml"
    with open(path, encoding="ascii") as f:
        raw = f.read()

    # Identify headline paragraphs: non-empty all-caps text (report uses
    # plain uppercase lines as section headlines; body text has lowercase).
    root = ET.fromstring(raw)
    headlines = []
    for p in root.iter(W + "p"):
        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(W + "t"))
        if text and text.isupper():
            headlines.append(text)
    if not headlines:
        sys.exit("error: no all-caps headline paragraphs found")
    seen = set(headlines)

    # Remove any pre-existing underline tags (restore baseline).
    raw = raw.replace(U_TAG, "")

    # For each headline occurrence, anchor on the run that ends with the
    # headline text (</w:t> followed by </w:r>), then insert <w:u> before the
    # LAST </w:rPr> inside that run's segment (its own run properties).
    edits = []
    for h in sorted(seen):
        pat = re.compile(
            r"<w:r>(?P<run>.*?)<w:t[^>]*>" + re.escape(h)
            + r"</w:t>\s*</w:r>",
            re.S)
        for m in pat.finditer(raw):
            run = m.group("run")
            rpr_open = run.rfind("<w:rPr>")
            rpr_close = run.rfind("</w:rPr>")
            if rpr_open == -1 or rpr_close == -1 or rpr_open > rpr_close:
                # Run has no run properties; create one right after <w:r>.
                edits.append((m.start("run") + len("<w:r>"),
                              "<w:rPr>" + U_TAG + "</w:rPr>"))
            else:
                rpr = run[rpr_open + len("<w:rPr>"):rpr_close]
                if U_TAG in rpr:
                    continue
                edits.append((m.start("run") + rpr_close, U_TAG))

    for idx, text in sorted(edits, key=lambda e: e[0], reverse=True):
        raw = raw[:idx] + text + raw[idx:]

    root = ET.fromstring(raw)  # well-formedness check before saving
    total_u = raw.count(U_TAG)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(raw)
    print("Underlined %d headline run(s) (%d <w:u> tag(s)); %s"
          % (len(edits), total_u, "; ".join(sorted(seen))))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
